title: Kenyan Honey Roast Chicken
community: Popular across Kenya at family celebrations
author: Mama Wanjiru
desc: Kenyan Honey Roast Chicken — a whole chicken marinated in wild Kenyan honey, garlic, ginger, and warm spices, then oven-roasted until the honey caramelises into a magnificent mahogany crust. The family celebration chicken — between the everyday and the grand feast.
longDesc: Honey roast chicken occupies the sweet spot in Kenyan celebration cooking — more impressive than everyday chicken but accessible enough for family birthday celebrations, school prize-giving dinners, and Sunday family gatherings. The Kenyan honey marinade applied and reapplied during roasting builds a deeply caramelised, fragrant crust that is simultaneously sweet, garlicky, and smoky.
ingredients: ½ cup fresh coriander — for stuffing
steps: Score the chicken deeply — legs, thighs, and breast, cutting to the bone.
Combine honey, garlic, ginger, lemon, oil, spices, salt, and pepper into a thick marinade.
Rub the marinade all over the chicken and deep into the scores.
Stuff the cavity with fresh coriander.
Marinate for 4 hours minimum — overnight preferred.
Place chicken in roasting tin. Roast for 30 minutes.
Baste generously with pan juices and any remaining marinade.
Roast for another 30—40 minutes, basting every 15 minutes.
The chicken is done when a skewer in the thigh runs clear.
chefTips: Wild Kenyan honey is the star — its complex floral character makes a dramatic difference.
Frequent basting in the final 30 minutes builds the mahogany crust layer by layer.
The coriander stuffed in the cavity perfumes the chicken from within.
commonMistakes: Too high oven temperature — honey burns before chicken is cooked.
Single marinade application — insufficient crust development.
cookingScience: See KEN190 for the full honey caramelisation science. In the oven environment, the Maillard reaction and caramelisation proceed more evenly than on the grill — producing a more uniform mahogany glaze across the whole bird.
sustainabilityTips: Free-range chicken and wild Kenyan honey are both sustainable choices.
healthBenefits: Wild honey adds antioxidants and antimicrobials.
culturalNote: Honey roast chicken has become one of Kenya's most beloved family celebration dishes — impressive enough to mark an occasion but accessible enough for a family Sunday dinner. The honey crust, glistening from the oven, is a visual statement of celebration.
